about.title: About THALVO
about.subtitle: Marine Operating System
about.body: THALVO is a Marine Operating System that connects boat owners, captains and sea enthusiasts with trusted marine mechanics, divers and marine parts suppliers when they need help at sea.
about.who_body: We are building a marine technology platform focused on trust, speed and transparency for life at sea.
about.purpose_body: Our goal is to bring SOS assistance, service offers, secure demo escrow, spare parts and mission tracking into one simple platform.
about.vision_body: THALVO aims to evolve into a wider MarineOS ecosystem covering marina services, fuel, insurance, vessel history, AIS, weather, routing, parts logistics and AI-powered marine intelligence.
about.tagline: The trusted operating system for life at sea.

state.awaiting_body: Once you accept a provider, a simulated escrow entry is created. No real payment provider is connected yet — nothing is captured from a real card.
state.pending_body: This is a test-mode escrow. Nothing is charged to a real card — you're authorizing a simulated hold so we can rehearse the release flow.
state.secured_body: This mission is tracked in test-mode escrow. No real money has been captured — a real payment provider will replace this before launch.
state.extras_body: The provider requested an extra part. Approve to add it to the simulated escrow — nothing is charged to a real card in test mode.
state.released_body: Payout ledger entry recorded for the provider wallet and platform commission. In test mode no real money moves — a payment provider will finalize this.
